validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed, strong. MEED (industry trade press, the row's own cited source) explicitly lists the segment: 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-4 to EWPS-6, covering 370km' as one of the 15 pipeline EPC packages of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3). url_verifier confirmed the page returns 200 and contains the exact tokens 'EWPS-4 to EWPS-6', '370', and '56-inch'. Independently corroborated that MGS-3 is a real, awarded, under-construction ~$8.8bn/~4,000 km program by JPT/SPE (OK 200, 'Master Gas System'+'2028') and World Oil (OK 200). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct — this is a 56-inch east-west gas transmission trunk (part of the national Master Gas System backbone), commodity gas, PipelineType transmission. Not gathering/process/lateral. DUPLICATE CHECK: P6724 ('EWPS-4-EWPS-6 "4"', also 185 km, 56 in) is the PARALLEL line 4 of the same EWPS-4->EWPS-6 corridor; MEED names 'pipelines three and four' (two physical lines), so P6723 (line 3) and P6724 (line 4) are two real parallel pipes, NOT a double-count. No duplicate against any other roster PID. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct — Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System. FuelSource Gas correct. Endpoints EWPS-4 (East-West Pump Station 4) -> EWPS-6 within Saudi Arabia; province not stated per-segment so left unfilled (no fabrication). SPEC: Diameter 56 in explicitly confirmed by MEED. LengthKnown 185 km is a caveat — the source states 370 km for the PAIR of lines (3 and 4); GEM split it 185+185, which is arithmetically consistent (185x2=370) and a defensible per-line modeling choice, so no material disagreement, but the 185 figure is inferred, not directly sourced. Capacity blank and left blank — MGS-3 adds 3.15 bscfd across ~4,000 km total; no defensible per-segment capacity, so not fabricated. StartYear1 2028 matches the project's Q4 2028 target completion.
